environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but with Cilium CNI L7 network policy applied to the webhook-processors namespace. Policy spec uses toFQDNs matchPattern for '*.example.com' and '*.partner-api.net' on ports 443/80 only, with default deny-all egress except DNS (kube-dns on port 53). Additionally, a Cilium L7 HTTP policy rule with headerMatches ensures outbound requests must contain the X-Webhook-Event header matching regex '^[a-z_]+$' — redirect responses to non-FQDN-matched destinations are dropped at the proxy layer before TCP connection establishment. The pod also runs with a read-only root filesystem and drops all capabilities except NET_BIND_SERVICE. An OPA Gatekeeper constraint (K8sBlockNodePort + custom rego) validates that no ServiceEntry or VirtualService can be created targeting RFC1918 or link-local ranges.
